'''Climbing Syntherope''' was a [[Syntherope/Legends|syntherope]] product produced by [[SureGrip]] for climbing purposes. Like [[Climbsuit/Legends|Climbsuits]], the rope was coated in [[FrictionGrip/Legends|FrictionGrip]] to ensure a superior hold when climbing up steep surfaces. The line was stored in a dispenser with reel and catch, and could support up to 500 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="ROE" />
